atleti: Raúl García was a second-striker/advanced-midfield utility player; assigned ST reserve under the 4-4-2 interpretation, while 18 La Liga starts make him starter-equivalent.
Gabi central CM and Tiago central deeper DM are 4-4-2 tactical simplification; neither their position frequencies nor Arda/Koke left-right majority has been exhaustively rechecked.
Diego Ribas returned January 2014; only 4 league starts and 13 appearances at Atlético, not the same season as his full 2011-12 Atlético loan.
Cristian Rodríguez 2 starts/20 substitute-heavy appearances, backup included due recurring on-field role. Javi Manquillo three 90-minute league starts, very limited reserve.
barca: Cesc Fàbregas started 28 La Liga games, more than Xavi's 26; the 4-3-3 tactical 'CM backup' tag is not a claim he was qualitatively a substitute.
Alexis Sánchez 19 league goals from 27 starts and 34 appearances, starter-equivalent despite nominal RW backup; Pedro 15 from 28.
Valdés played 26, Pinto 13 due Valdés injury; Oier Olazábal did not feature and is not an eligible goalkeeper.
Neymar played majority left-sided, Messi center-forward/false nine, but exact multi-game role census unverified.
Historical FootballSquads vs FC Barcelona profile Adriano date of birth discrepancy unresolved; 1984-10-26 provisional.
madrid: 2013-14 Ancelotti's adapted 4-3-3: Ángel Di María moved to left CM, not automatically RW from his earlier seasons; Modrić CM, Bale RW.
Casillas just 2 La Liga starts (2 apps) but substantial Champions League/Copa goalkeeper role, so entered as valid cup-starter-equivalent GK backup without inventing league starts.
Özil moved to Arsenal after two La Liga starts; not retained over season-long nominees; Isco 23 starts and used CM/CAM, classified tactical CM backup.
Benzema 34 starts; Morata 3 starts and 23 apps, relevant impact as substitute (8 league goals); backup ST.
Isco, Di María and Marcelo sometimes used multiple positions; per-match majority not independently certified.
athletic: Ernesto Valverde 4-2-3-1/4-3-3 tactical split interpreted as DM Iturraspe, CMs Herrera & Mikel Rico; position roles not game-by-game counted.
Óscar de Marcos was versatile RB/winger/AM and played 19 starts / 35 apps; listed RB backup provisionally, must verify his predominant match-specific role.
Ibai Gómez scored eight league goals with only six starts, meaningful LW rotation candidate.
Enric Saborit just two starts and five league appearances; qualified as a literal specialist LB backup, low-use rotation C+.
Mikel San José 19 starts / 25 appearances and was a starter-equivalent center-back option.
sevilla: UEFA 2013/14 technical report depicts Sevilla 4-2-3-1 becoming 4-2-4, with Fazio/Pareja as first-choice CB, Rakitić creative role.
Daniel Carriço alternated CB/DM. DM starter is provisional tactical projection; some contemporary sources list him as centre back.
Coke and Diogo Figueiras both started heavily (23 and 19 league games); RB backup label is tactical not inferior.
Kévin Gameiro 15 league goals from 20 starts, more than Carlos Bacca 14 from 27 starts; reserve nomination is not performance demotion.
Kevin Gameiro DOB 1987-05-09 confirmed France FFF and Atlético official; FootballSquads 2014-15 archive inaccurately reports 1987-04-09; conflict logged.
José Antonio Reyes primarily used on the flanks but side classification LW vs RW needs match checks; 2013/14 Transfermarkt squad lists RW.
Geoffrey Kondogbia had only two 2013-14 Sevilla league appearances before Monaco transfer; not selected, preventing carryover of 2012-13 source records.
villarreal: Marcelino's 4-4-2, Giovani dos Santos and Uche are striker pair; Perbet another 10-goal starter-equivalent alternative.
Bruno Soriano as DM, Manu Trigueros as more advanced CM is a role distinction within a two-man center; Cani wide left and Javier Aquino wide right require match-level confirmation.
Gabriel Paulista and José Dorado each started 17; Gabriel as CB starter is tactical quality judgment, Dorado still backup starter-equivalent.
Óliver Torres transferred on loan from Atlético during season; not included due limited Villarreal role (6 starts), avoiding season team/position double placement.
Hernán Pérez was loaned out mid-season; listed Villarreal RW rotation only for club-scoped 13 appearances.
No ranking bonus for finishing sixth; compare individual current roles and three-year continuity.
sociedad: Real Sociedad finished seventh, actually entered 2014-15 UEL, defeated in play-off by Krasnodar; selected despite not reaching group stage.
Griezmann 16 league goals in 31 starts and Carlos Vela 16 in 35; separate LW and RW positional nominations.
Iñigo Martínez established starting CB with 35 starts; Mikel González 20, Ansotegi 18 as regular center-back rotation.
Xabi Prieto rotated across attacking midfield and right flank, but one CAM role chosen as tactical approximation; match-level predominance pending.
José Ángel Valdés and Alberto de la Bella had 22 and 16 starts respectively; left-back starter/backup roles are season-specific, not former draft carryover.
Sergio Canales joined mid-season, Real Sociedad only 13 league starts, not the Valencia 2012-13 season.

reviewWarnings: This dataset is not fact-certified for all individual 3-season comparisons
Some role nominations and full date cross-checks are open; no unearned full verification claims
Nominal backups can be starter-equivalent and are not a performance demotion
Iago Herrerín 1988-01-25 corroborated Athletic Club official profile; previous Football Archive 1988-03-13 is inaccurate.
FC Barcelona current official player archive supports Adriano Correia 1984-10-26, whereas an older FC Barcelona document reports 1984-10-20; conflict retained.
2012/13–2016/17 multi-season La Liga tactics analysis supports composite 4-2-3-1, not full 2013-14-only census.
